#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>

int main() {
    std::ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    std::cin.tie(nullptr);

    std::string input_line;
    std::getline(std::cin, input_line);
    std::istringstream iss(input_line);
    int n, bitCoins;
    iss >> n >> bitCoins;

    std::string values_line;
    std::getline(std::cin, values_line);
    std::istringstream values_stream(values_line);
    std::vector<int> values(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        values_stream >> values[i];
    }

    int odd = 0;
    int even = 0;
    int count = 0;
    std::vector<int> val;

    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
        if (values[i] % 2 == 0) {
            ++even;
        } else {
            ++odd;
        }
        if (odd == even) {
            int diff = values[i + 1] - values[i];
            if (diff < 0) {
                diff = -diff;
            }
            val.push_back(diff);
        }
    }

    std::sort(val.begin(), val.end());

    for (size_t j = 0; j < val.size(); ++j) {
        if (val[j] <= bitCoins) {
            bitCoins -= val[j];
            ++count;
        } else {
            break;
        }
    }

    std::cout << count << "\n";

    return 0;
}
